conversion_rule: PS2 inputs -> Tekken-style inputs. Square (Jab)=1, Triangle (Punch)=2, Circle (Kick)=4. X (hold) = crouch/block modifier. R1/R2 = spirit-move buttons -> Tekken 1+2/3+4-family slots. Directions relative to facing. Combo strings recorded as Tekken sequences with the verbatim PS2 string in notes; Tekken strings estimated. Hold-to-repeat noted on Finger Flip Bullets.
limb_convention: 1=armR(LP), 2=armL(HP), 3=legL(LK), 4=legR(HK); input keys prefixed ~ are dictionary variants sharing an input
